label: Full Lining
description: A fully lined jacket has its entire interior — back, sides, front panels, and sleeves — covered with a smooth lining fabric, typically Bemberg cupro or silk, which makes the jacket slip effortlessly over a shirt, helps it retain its pressed shape, and finishes the interior to a uniform standard. Full lining is the default for formal suits, winter-weight cloths, and any jacket intended for frequent wear in professional settings, as it prolongs the life of the outer cloth by reducing friction. The lining also provides an opportunity to introduce colour, pattern, or a monogrammed label as a hidden personal statement.
